assessment_objectives.objective: Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection code, queries and transformation logic are maintained under version control.
changes to Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection code, queries and transformation logic are peer reviewed by an individual other than the author prior to deployment.
changes to Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection code, queries and transformation logic are tested prior to deployment to confirm they produce the intended results.
changes to Control Assurance Automation (CAA) collection code, queries and transformation logic are authorized through change management, with approval recorded prior to deployment.

the level of review, testing and change management rigor applied to Control Assurance Automation (CAA) logic is defined commensurate with the sensitivity of the Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) accessed.
